analytics.name: Analytic 1111
analytics.guidance: Detects abuse of AuthorizationExecuteWithPrivileges API to gain elevated privileges via user credential prompts, typically through invocation of /usr/libexec/security_authtrampoline. Detection involves correlation of API usage, binary reputation, and prompt context.

tuning.description: Allow list of trusted binaries invoking elevation prompts
Temporal correlation threshold between API call and credential prompt
Heuristic filters to determine whether a prompt context matches known legitimate installers

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
